paragraphs.text: Angelic Harold is a legendary Angel Performer from Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Harold is an angel singer who performs in Myra's Astrotorium. He has a condition called "Devil's Ankle" in which his left ankle is that of a devil due to a deal gone wrong (although the description text is ambiguous about his legs). He has been the park's Employee of the Month.
